description: This file contains the definition and implementation of the YAHOO UI Framework's Container module, including classes such as Module and Config, with functions for managing UI containers, event handling, rendering, and configuration management.

classes.name: YAHOO.util.Config
classes.description: A utility class for managing configuration properties with change events and validation.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.Module
classes.description: A class representing a UI container element with methods for content management, rendering, event handling, and configuration.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.Panel
classes.description: A Panel class that extends YAHOO.widget.Overlay, providing features like draggable headers, close button, modal mask, focus management, and customizable content.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.Panel
classes.description: A class that extends YAHOO.widget.Overlay, providing features like draggable headers, close button, modal mask, focus management, and customizable content.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.Dialog
classes.description: A subclass of Panel that implements a modal dialog with form submission, buttons, focus management, and event handling.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.SimpleDialog
classes.description: A simplified implementation of Dialog that supports single value submission and preset icons.

classes.name: YAHOO.widget.ContainerEffect
classes.description: Encapsulates animation transitions for overlays, with pre-configured effects such as fade.

methods.name: YAHOO.util.Config.init
methods.description: Initializes configuration with owner reference, event setup, and default config objects.

methods.name: YAHOO.widget.Module.init
methods.description: Initializes a Module instance, sets up DOM references, applies configuration, and instantiates event handling.

methods.name: YAHOO.widget.Module.render
methods.description: Renders the module into the DOM, appending necessary elements and firing render events.

methods.name: align
methods.description: Positions the overlay relative to a specified element and context, with optional XY offsets. Uses predefined corner constants to determine alignment points and moves the overlay accordingly.

methods.name: enforceConstraints
methods.description: Event handler to ensure overlay stays within the viewport when move events occur, adjusting position properties as needed.

methods.name: _getConstrainedPos
methods.description: Shared method to compute constrained x or y position based on viewport, scroll, overlay size, and preventOverlap settings.

methods.name: _preventOverlap
methods.description: Helper to adjust overlay positioning to prevent overlap with a given context element, flipping position if necessary.

methods.name: getConstrainedX
methods.description: Returns the constrained x position value, ensuring overlay remains within viewport horizontally.

methods.name: getConstrainedY
methods.description: Returns the constrained y position value, ensuring overlay remains within viewport vertically.

methods.name: getConstrainedXY
methods.description: Returns an array with x and y coordinates adjusted to kept overlay within viewport bounds.

methods.name: center
methods.description: Centers the overlay within the viewport, adjusting x and y properties.

methods.name: syncPosition
methods.description: Synchronizes the overlay's position properties ('x', 'y', 'xy') with its actual DOM position for drag/drop updates.

methods.name: onDomResize
methods.description: Handles resize events, updates overlay position, and triggers iframe and context events.

methods.name: _getComputedHeight
methods.description: Calculates element height using getComputedStyle or offsetHeight, depending on browser support.

methods.name: _validateAutoFillHeight
methods.description: Validates if autofill height setting is one of the predefined strings (body/header/footer).

methods.name: _autoFillOnHeightChange
methods.description: Event handler to resize fill-height elements when height property changes, if autofill is enabled.

methods.name: _getPreciseHeight
methods.description: Returns sub-pixel height using getBoundingClientRect if available, otherwise falls back to offsetHeight.

methods.name: fillHeight
methods.description: Adjusts the specified element's height to fill remaining space within the container, based on its content height calculations.

methods.name: bringToTop
methods.description: Reorders overlays in the z-index stack to bring this overlay above others.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes overlay and iframe elements, unsubscribes from events, cleans up references to facilitate garbage collection.

methods.name: forceContainerRedraw
methods.description: Forces a repaint/redraw of the overlay container element by toggling a CSS class.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the overlay instance.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the Panel, sets up DOM references, event subscriptions, default configurations, and default DOM structures.

methods.name: _onElementFocus
methods.description: Handles focus events to enforce modality by redirecting focus within focusable elements.

methods.name: _focusFirstModal
methods.description: Focuses the first focusable element within the Panel when it is shown modally.

methods.name: _addFocusHandlers
methods.description: Adds event handlers to enforce modality by listening for focus events.

methods.name: _createHiddenFocusElement
methods.description: Creates an off-screen hidden button to trap focus for modal Panels.

methods.name: _removeFocusHandlers
methods.description: Removes focus event handlers when hiding the modal overlay.

methods.name: _focusOnShow
methods.description: Handles focus behavior after the Panel is displayed, ensuring focus is directed appropriately.

methods.name: focusFirst
methods.description: Sets focus to the first focusable element inside the Panel.

methods.name: focusLast
methods.description: Sets focus to the last focusable element inside the Panel.

methods.name: _setTabLoop
methods.description: Internal method to set up tab order looping between first and last focusable elements.

methods.name: setTabLoop
methods.description: Configure tab and shift-tab focus loops between specified focusable elements.

methods.name: getFocusableElements
methods.description: Retrieves all focusable elements within the Panel based on predefined focusable tags.

methods.name: _testIfFocusable
methods.description: Determines if an element is focusable, can be overridden for custom behavior.

methods.name: setFirstLastFocusable
methods.description: Identifies and stores references to the first and last focusable elements in the Panel.

methods.name: initEvents
methods.description: Initializes custom events for modality, dragging, and masking.

methods.name: initDefaultConfig
methods.description: Defines default configurable properties like close button, draggable, underlay, modal, key listeners, and UI strings.

methods.name: configClose
methods.description: Handles the display of the close icon based on the 'close' configuration property.

methods.name: _doClose
methods.description: Event handler to close (hide) the Panel when the close icon is clicked.

methods.name: configDraggable
methods.description: Enables or disables draggable header via DragDrop utility, with browser-specific adjustments.

methods.name: configUnderlay
methods.description: Configures the underlay (shadow, matte, none) for the Panel and handles creation/deletion of overlay elements.

methods.name: configModal
methods.description: Enables or disables modal mask behavior, managing event subscriptions for mask display.

methods.name: removeMask
methods.description: Removes the modal mask element from DOM.

methods.name: sizeMask
methods.description: Adjusts the modal mask size to cover the entire document viewport.

methods.name: stackMask
methods.description: Sets the modal mask's z-index to be below the Panel.

methods.name: buildWrapper
methods.description: Wraps the Panel element in a container div and sets positioning classes.

methods.name: sizeUnderlay
methods.description: Resizes the underlay element to match Panel size.

methods.name: registerDragDrop
methods.description: Initializes DragDrop instance for header dragging, handling constraints.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Calls the superclass render method to render the Panel into the specified container.

methods.name: _renderHeader
methods.description: Renders the header into the panel's DOM element.

methods.name: _renderBody
methods.description: Renders the body content into the panel's DOM element.

methods.name: _renderFooter
methods.description: Renders the footer content into the panel's DOM element.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Removes the Panel element from the DOM and cleans up associated event listeners and masks.

methods.name: forceUnderlayRedraw
methods.description: Forces repaint of the underlay element by toggling a CSS class.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Panel object.

methods.name: ContainerEffect.FADE
methods.description: Creates a fade in/out animation effect for an overlay, configuring opacity transitions with event hooks for underlay handling, start, and completion of animateIn and animateOut sequences.

methods.name: ContainerEffect.SLIDE
methods.description: Creates a slide in/out animation effect for an overlay, moving its position horizontally based on window width, with event handlers to manage animation steps.
